questions.q: Pointing to a man, a woman said, "His mother is the only daughter of my father." How is the man related to the woman?
questions.s:
Decoding symbols for Family Tree:

Step-by-step Relationship Analysis:

Breakdown the statement made by the woman: "His (the man's) mother is the only daughter of my father."

  • "The only daughter of my father" – Since the speaker is a woman, her father's only daughter must be herself.
  • Now, replace that part in the sentence: "His mother is "me" (the woman)."
  • If the woman is the mother of the man, then the man is her "Son".

Consolidated Family Structure:

The woman is the mother of the man. Therefore, the man is the woman's son.

Thus, the man is the Son of the woman.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"

questions.q: The students of a class donated a sum of Rs. 2,809 to the Fund. Each student donated as many rupees as the number of students in the class. The number of students in the class is:
questions.s:
Given:

Class donated a sum of Rs. 2,809

Each student donated as many rupees as the number of students in the class.

Calculation:

Let the total number of the students be 'x'

Each student will donate 'x' amount of rupees.

So, total class fund = Donation of each student × Total number of students

⇒ 2,809 = x × x

⇒ 2,809 = x2 

⇒ x = 53

∴ Total number of students in class is 53

questions.q: If the sum of two numbers is 25 and their product is 144, then what is the position difference between the two numbers?
questions.s:
Given:

The sum of the two numbers is 25

Their product is 144

Formula used:

(a - b)2 = (a + b)2 - 4ab

Calculation:

We have

x + y = 25           -----(1)  

⇒ xy = 144          -----(2)

By using the above identity

(x - y)2 = (x + y)2 - 4xy

(x - y)2 = (25)2 - 4 × 144

(x - y)2 = 625 - 576

(x - y)2 = 49

(x - y) = 7

∴ The answer is 7.

questions.q:
In a certain code language-

'P + Q' means 'P is the wife of Q'.

'P - Q' means 'P is the father of Q'.

'P X Q' means 'P is the daughter-in-law of Q'.

'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the brother of Q'.

If A X D + N - B ÷ G + S, then which of the following statement is true?

I) S is the son-in-law of D.

II) B is the son of N.

III) G is the sister-in-law of A.

एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में-

'P + Q' का अर्थ है 'P, Q की पत्नी है'।

'P - Q' का अर्थ है 'P, Q का पिता है'।

'P X Q' का अर्थ है 'P, Q की डॉटर-इन-लॉ है'।

'P ÷ Q' का अर्थ है 'P, Q का भाई है'।

यदि A X D + N - B ÷ G + S, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सत्य है?

I) S, D का सन-इन-लॉ है।

II) B, N का पुत्र है।

III) G, A की सिस्टर-इन-लॉ है।
o: Only I and II are trueकेवल I और II सत्य हैं
Only I is trueकेवल I सत्य हैं
Only II and III are trueकेवल II और III सत्य हैं
All are trueसभी सत्य है
questions.s:
A X D + N - B ÷ G + S

A X D means 'A is the daughter-in-law of D'.

D + N means 'D is the wife of N'.

N - B means 'N is the father of B'.

B ÷ G means 'B is the brother of G'.

G + S means 'G is the wife of S'.

S is the son-in-law of D.

B is the son of N.

G is the sister-in-law of A.

All these statements are true.

questions_hin.q_hi: If the sum of two numbers is 25 and their product is 144, then what is the position difference between the two numbers?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given:

The sum of the two numbers is 25

Their product is 144

Formula used:

(a - b)2 = (a + b)2 - 4ab

Calculation:

We have

x + y = 25           -----(1)  

⇒ xy = 144          -----(2)

By using the above identity

(x - y)2 = (x + y)2 - 4xy

(x - y)2 = (25)2 - 4 × 144

(x - y)2 = 625 - 576

(x - y)2 = 49

(x - y) = 7

∴ The answer is 7.

questions_hin.q_hi: Q12. In which type of geological formation are gorges most commonly developed? / गॉर्ज (gorges) सबसे अधिक किस प्रकार के भूवैज्ञानिक निर्माण में विकसित होते हैं? [SSC CGL Tier 1, 13 Sep 2025, Shift-1]
questions_hin.s_hi: Dramatic, deep gorges with incredibly steep, often perfectly vertical walls are overwhelmingly most commonly developed strictly in highly resistant "Hard rocks" (like solid granite or tough resistant limestone). In these hard rock areas, the aggressive river furiously cuts vertically downwards (down-cutting) much faster than the incredibly tough sides can weather or collapse. / अविश्वसनीय रूप से खड़ी, अक्सर पूरी तरह से लंबवत दीवारों वाले नाटकीय, गहरे गॉर्ज भारी रूप से सबसे अधिक कड़ाई से अत्यधिक प्रतिरोधी "कठोर चट्टानों" (जैसे ठोस ग्रेनाइट या सख्त प्रतिरोधी चूना पत्थर) में विकसित होते हैं। इन कठोर चट्टानी क्षेत्रों में, आक्रामक नदी अविश्वसनीय रूप से सख्त किनारों के मौसम या ढहने की तुलना में बहुत तेज गति से लंबवत रूप से नीचे की ओर (डाउन-कटिंग) कटती है।

questions_hin.q_hi:
In a certain code language-

'P + Q' means 'P is the wife of Q'.

'P - Q' means 'P is the father of Q'.

'P X Q' means 'P is the daughter-in-law of Q'.

'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the brother of Q'.

If A X D + N - B ÷ G + S, then which of the following statement is true?

I) S is the son-in-law of D.

II) B is the son of N.

III) G is the sister-in-law of A.

एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में-

'P + Q' का अर्थ है 'P, Q की पत्नी है'।

'P - Q' का अर्थ है 'P, Q का पिता है'।

'P X Q' का अर्थ है 'P, Q की डॉटर-इन-लॉ है'।

'P ÷ Q' का अर्थ है 'P, Q का भाई है'।

यदि A X D + N - B ÷ G + S, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सत्य है?

I) S, D का सन-इन-लॉ है।

II) B, N का पुत्र है।

III) G, A की सिस्टर-इन-लॉ है।
o_hi: Only I and II are trueकेवल I और II सत्य हैं
Only I is trueकेवल I सत्य हैं
Only II and III are trueकेवल II और III सत्य हैं
All are trueसभी सत्य है
questions_hin.s_hi:
A X D + N - B ÷ G + S

A X D means 'A is the daughter-in-law of D'.

D + N means 'D is the wife of N'.

N - B means 'N is the father of B'.

B ÷ G means 'B is the brother of G'.

G + S means 'G is the wife of S'.

S is the son-in-law of D.

B is the son of N.

G is the sister-in-law of A.

All these statements are true.
